inventorywizard.mode.default.description: Groups items by kind (stone, wood, tools, food, ...), then by name. The hotbar puts weapons and tools first.
inventorywizard.mode.alphabetical.descri: Orders items A to Z by name.
inventorywizard.mode.stack_based.descrip: Orders items A to Z by name, largest stacks first, without merging stacks.
inventorywizard.message.all_sorted: 🧙✨ Complete inventory enchanted by the InventoryWizard! (%s)
inventorywizard.message.disabled: That kind of sorting is turned off in the InventoryWizard config.
inventorywizard.message.slot_locked: 🔒 Slot locked: sorting will leave it alone
inventorywizard.message.singleplayer_onl: InventoryWizard only works in singleplayer worlds, as the LAN host, or on servers with the InventoryWizard plugin.
inventorywizard.config.title: InventoryWizard Settings
inventorywizard.config.preview.tooltip: How the selected mode sorts some sample items. Change the mode or the partial stack settings to watch them move.
inventorywizard.config.preview.unavailab: Join a world to see a preview of the sort mode
inventorywizard.config.tip.lock: Alt+click a slot to lock it in place
inventorywizard.config.tip.shift_click: Shift+right-click in any inventory to sort it
inventorywizard.config.tip.scroll: Scroll while holding a stack to grab or drop one item
inventorywizard.config.tip.command: /iwiz mode switches sort modes from chat
inventorywizard.config.show_messages.too: Show a chat message after sorting or changing the sort mode.
inventorywizard.config.show_buttons.tool: Show sort and sort mode buttons in the inventory, chest and shulker box screens.
inventorywizard.config.check_for_updates: Check Modrinth for a newer version at startup and mention it in chat. Takes effect after a restart.
inventorywizard.config.usage_stats.toolt: Share pseudonymous usage stats at startup: a random install ID and your mod, Minecraft, loader, Java and OS versions. No names, chat or world data. Turning it off deletes what was shared. See PRIVACY.md on the mod's page.
inventorywizard.usage_stats.consent.mess:
May InventoryWizard send usage stats when the game starts? That's a random install ID (not linked to your account) and your InventoryWizard, Minecraft, loader, Java and OS versions. No names, chat, worlds or IP addresses are stored.

Change this any time with Usage Stats in InventoryWizard's settings; turning it off deletes your data. Under 16? Ask a parent first. Full details: PRIVACY.md on the mod's page.
inventorywizard.config.sound_volume.tool: How loud the sort sound plays.
inventorywizard.config.sound_pitch.toolt: How high the sort sound plays. Locking a slot or changing the mode plays it a little higher.
inventorywizard.config.preview_sound.too: Play the sort sound with the volume and pitch above.
inventorywizard.config.feature.chest.too: Chests, trapped chests, chest minecarts and chest boats.
inventorywizard.config.scroll_adjusts_st: While carrying a stack, scroll up to take one more item from the slot you picked it up from, or down to put one back.
inventorywizard.config.partial_stacks.ch: When off, leftover partial stacks in containers are placed after all full stacks.
inventorywizard.config.partial_stacks.in: When off, leftover partial stacks in your inventory are placed after all full stacks.
inventorywizard.config.keybinds.tooltip: Change the Sort and Cycle Sorting Mode keys (under InventoryWizard).
inventorywizard.config.unlock_slots.tool: Alt+click a slot in your inventory to lock it, so sorting leaves it alone. This unlocks every slot.
inventorywizard.config.reset.tooltip: Put every setting on this screen back to its default. Locked slots are kept.
inventorywizard.config.reset.confirm.mes: Every setting on this screen goes back to its default. Locked slots are kept.
